name: Do I need a dedicated shut-off valve for my dishwasher?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a dedicated shut-off valve for my dishwasher?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to have a dedicated shut-off valve for your dishwasher. This allows you to easily turn off the water supply to the appliance for maintenance or in case of a leak without affecting the water supply to the rest of your home. It’s a critical safety feature that helps prevent potential water damage. During our installation process, we ensure a dedicated shut-off valve is properly installed and accessible, if not already present.
acceptedAnswer.description: A dedicated shut-off valve for your dishwasher is highly recommended for easy maintenance and to prevent water damage without affecting your home's main water supply.
